title: Sentient
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Giants, goblins, wisps and wispmothers, spriggans, hagravens and rieklings, the Creation Club goblins and spriggans included. The giants and hagravens take the levels the user set in `archetype-tiers.md` (giants 38, hagravens 40), so their bands sit above their vanilla levels.

the Creation Club goblins (all level 6), the Blue God and Gogh
Spriggan 8, Matron 18, Earth Mother 30, Burnt Spriggan 28, the CC Corrupted, Blooming and Enraged Spriggans, and the Spriggan Swarm
the Hagraven 20 and the named hagravens: Melka, Lucerne, the Altar of Thrond three, Moira, Drascua, the Glenmoril Witches
the four riekling rungs Riekling 6 → Warrior 23, the Thirsk chief and the CC chiefs
